items.fromString:
{{SizeRotatingFileAuditEndpoint}} has several size-tracking issues that can cause audit log rotation to happen at the wrong time.

*Problem*

* When the server restarts, an existing non-empty audit log file is treated as empty unless {{rotateOnBoot}} is enabled.
* Written size is calculated using the JVM default charset instead of the charset used to write the file.
* Rotation does not happen correctly when the file is already at the limit, or when the next log message would make it reach the limit.

*Impact*

* Rotation can happen too late.
* Log messages can end up in the wrong file.
* Size tracking can be wrong when a non-default charset is configured.

*Fix*

* Initialize the current size from the existing file length when reopening the log.
* Count bytes using the same charset as the file writer.
* Rotate before writing when the current file is already full or the next write would make it full.

*Tests*

* Added regression coverage for restart with an existing log file.
* Added regression coverage for exact-threshold rotation.
* Added regression coverage for threshold crossing on the next write.
* Added regression coverage for charset-aware size tracking.

{{SizeRotatingFileAuditEndpoint}} has several size-tracking issues that can cause audit log rotation to happen at the wrong time.

h3. Problem

* When the server restarts, an existing non-empty audit log file is treated as empty unless {{rotateOnBoot}} is enabled.
* Written size is calculated using the JVM default charset instead of the charset used to write the file.
* This causes {{currentSize}} tracking to be wrong, which can make rotation happen too late.

h3. Impact

* Rotation can happen too late after restart because the existing file size is not counted.
* Size tracking can be wrong when a non-default charset is configured.
* Log records can be written to the active file based on incorrect size accounting.

h3. Fix

* Initialize {{currentSize}} from the existing file length when reopening the log.
* Count bytes using the same charset as the file writer.
* Preserve the existing rotation behavior while fixing size accounting.

h3. Tests

* Added regression coverage for restart with an existing log file.
* Added regression coverage for initializing {{currentSize}} from the existing file length.
* Added regression coverage to preserve the existing threshold behavior.
* Added regression coverage for charset-aware size tracking.

items.toString:
{{LRURealmIdentityCache}} has a couple of concurrency and consistency issues that can cause problems under load.

It uses an access-order {{LinkedHashMap}}, where calling {{get()}} actually modifies internal state. Right now, access to this isn’t properly synchronized, which can lead to race conditions and inconsistent behaviour when multiple threads are involved.

There’s also an issue with cleanup. When entries are evicted or expire, they aren’t always removed from {{domainPrincipalMap}}, which can leave stale reverse mappings behind. Over time, this can lead to incorrect lookups and unnecessary memory usage.

This issue proposes adding proper synchronization around cache access and ensuring that reverse mappings are cleaned up whenever entries are removed.

Overall, this should make the cache thread-safe and keep its state consistent under concurrent use.
